nodes.label: ADR 0166: GLUE Home rechecks verdicts and tidies
nodes.rationale: GLUE Home does verdict re-checking and open-time repairs (tidying, matching, joining copies) in Rust when opening a collection and analyzing, not the page. A rule change reaches the library without a tab open. Tests: tests/golden/<file>/recheck.json, tests/golden/store/{tidy,join}/. The page with GLUE Home does neither (ADR 0162).
